---
title: "LLM Experiments"

Research findings from experiments with open-weight language models.

## About

This site documents experiments probing the behaviour of open-weight LLMs (Phi-3, Llama 3, Mistral, and others). Each experiment is run locally via [Ollama](https://ollama.com/) or via hosted APIs, with full code and data published for reproducibility.

## Setup

All experiments can be reproduced using the code in the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/JamieMJohnson/llm-experiments). You'll need:

- [Ollama](https://ollama.com/) for local models
- A free [Together AI](https://api.together.xyz/signup) API key for hosted models
- Python 3.8+ with Jupyter
